title: Himachal Snow Adventure (Manali, Solang Valley & Shimla)
hotel_name: The Himalayan Resort Manali & Snow Valley Resort Shimla
description: Escape to snow-capped Himalayan peaks. Enjoy skiing and paragliding in Solang Valley, drive through the engineering marvel Atal Tunnel, explore Kasol Manikaran pine valleys, and stroll along Shimla Mall Road.
highlights: Snow Activities, Skiing & Paragliding in Solang Valley
Scenic Drive through World's Longest Tunnel: Atal Tunnel Sissu
Hadimba Wooden Temple & Jogini Waterfall Trek in Manali
Shimla Ridge, Mall Road Shopping & Jakhoo Temple Ropeway
Campfire with Live Acoustic Music Session

included_services.meals: Daily Hot Buffet Breakfast & Buffet Dinner
included_services.transport: Private AC Vehicle for Full Circuit (Delhi-Shimla-Manali-Delhi)

excluded_services: Solang Valley Paragliding / Skiing Gear Rental Charges
Rohtang Pass NGT Special Permit Fee

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla Scenic Mountain Drive
itinerary.description: Morning pickup from Delhi Airport/Railway Station. Drive through Pinjore gardens up winding Himalayan highway to Shimla. Check-in to hotel.

itinerary.title: Shimla Kufri Snow View & Mall Road
itinerary.description: Visit Kufri winter sports point for yak rides and snow views. Afternoon walk along Mall Road, Scandal Point, Christ Church, and Jakhoo Hanuman Temple ropeway.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali via Kullu Valley Drive
itinerary.description: Picturesque drive alongside Beas river. En-route river rafting in Kullu and visit famous Kullu Shawl weaving factory.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Snow Adventure & Atal Tunnel
itinerary.description: Full day snow adventure at Solang Valley. Drive through 9.02 km Atal Tunnel to Sissu village in Lahaul Valley. Enjoy skiing, ATV rides, and paragliding.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing & Jogini Waterfall Trek
itinerary.description: Visit 450-year-old Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht hot water springs, Old Manali cafes, and short nature trek to Jogini Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi Return Journey
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel, buy Apple cider and Himachali caps. Drive back to Delhi for onward departure flight.

cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 7 days prior. 50% refund 3-6 days prior.
travel_tips: Rent heavy snow boots and woolens at Solang Valley shops
Keep Motion Sickness medicine handy for winding ghat roads

faqs.question: Is Rohtang Pass open all year?
faqs.answer: Rohtang Pass closes in heavy snow (Dec-May), but Solang Valley and Atal Tunnel remain open.
